$comment: Do-not-translate terms for Critterpass catalogs. Translator/reviewer reference for Tolgee; not yet machine-enforced (see notes). Sourced from docs/design-system.md and docs/product-decisions.md — update this file, not the source docs, if a term's spelling changes.

doNotTranslate.note: App name; never transliterated or translated.
Consumable purchase name; UI chip copy may shorten to "Boost" — keep either form untranslated.
Bali guide (gecko); also the guest guide shown outside the 6 launch destinations.

notes: Critter species/form names are not enumerated here yet: the content factory (docs/product-decisions.md's guide-content pipeline) has not produced the final critter roster this glossary would need to list. Add them here once that content ships, before the first non-en release of any catalog that references them.

`<local lang="...">` markup spans (packages/i18n/src/local-markup.ts) mark inline text that keeps a fixed language regardless of the surrounding locale (for example a Balinese greeting inside an English message) — never translate a span's content when translating the message around it.

This file is a translator/reviewer reference today, not wired into an automated check. A real follow-up once a Tolgee project exists: either import it as an organization-level Tolgee glossary (POST /v2/organizations/{organizationId}/glossaries) so Tolgee's own editor flags these terms, or extend tools/scripts/i18n/check-complete.ts to flag a shipped-locale translation that accidentally translates one of these terms.
